title: Set Up and Test a Local AI Model
description: Install Ollama and run an open-weights AI model entirely on your own machine — no internet required.
steps: Go to ollama.com and follow the installation instructions for your OS
Run: "ollama pull llama3.2" to download a compact model
Ask it the same 5 questions you regularly ask ChatGPT
Note: quality differences, speed differences, and what it cannot do that cloud AI can
expectedOutput: A running local AI setup and a personal assessment: when would you use local AI vs cloud AI?
bonusChallenges: Install Open WebUI for a ChatGPT-like interface to your local Ollama models
Try a larger model if your hardware supports it (llama3.1:8b or 13b)
